title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_frostblood_by_elly_blake_o3rkc (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_frostblood_by_elly_blake_o3rkc' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
